  html:

    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
format-links: false

  contents: "**/*.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
  fields: [image, date, title, reading-time, description, categories]
comments: false

Welcome! Here you'll find posts about my teaching, research, data science, and academic life.
